params.name: accessURL
params.description: Complete access URL of the Web Service (not the WSDL file's URL)

params.name: soapAction
params.description: Contents of the SOAPAction field of the request, typically "ServiceName#MethodName"

params.name: methodName
params.description: Name of the remote method of the Web Service to execute

params.name: nameSpace
params.description: XML namespace used for the SOAP request

params.name: complexType
params.description: Configuration of the Web Service's input/output parameter complexity (publication mode RPC/DOC x simple/complex parameters)

sentinelValues.meaning: Web Service dynamic: RPC mode, simple input and output (default if omitted)
Web Service manual in: RPC mode, complex input (manual XML BLOB via WEB SERVICE SET PARAMETER), simple output
Web Service manual out: RPC mode, simple input, complex output (manual XML BLOB retrieved via WEB SERVICE GET RESULT)
Web Service manual: RPC mode with complex input and output, or DOC mode -- both input and output are manual XML BLOBs

params.description: If passed, keeps the underlying connection open for reuse by the next WEB SERVICE CALL instead of closing it at the end of execution

overloads.semanticRole: Sends a SOAP HTTP request built from the parameters previously registered via WEB SERVICE SET PARAMETER to the Web Service designated by accessURL/soapAction/methodName/nameSpace, replacing any previous result.

jointConstraints.rule: The trailing '*' occupies the parameter slot after complexType in the signature, so complexType must be passed (even if its default value) for '*' to be reachable.

constraints: Passing https:// in accessURL enables secure (SSL/TLS) mode automatically; an invalid server certificate sets OK to 0 and raises error 901, interceptable via ON ERR CALL.

Calling WEB SERVICE CALL erases any result from a previously called Web Service and replaces it with the new result(s); each new WEB SERVICE SET PARAMETER call after this one starts building a fresh request.

protocolRefs.multiCallChain: Web Services (Client) SOAP call sequence: WEB SERVICE AUTHENTICATE (optional) and/or WEB SERVICE SET OPTION (optional) configure per-call client state -> WEB SERVICE SET PARAMETER is called once per request parameter to build the SOAP message -> WEB SERVICE CALL sends the request (consuming the authenticate/option/parameter state and erasing any previous result) -> WEB SERVICE GET RESULT retrieves each returned value (pass '*' on the final call to free memory) -> on error, WEB SERVICE Get info can be called from an ON ERR CALL method to inspect the SOAP fault.
